initialExam.title: Chhattisgarh Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Chhattisgarh Police Constable recruitment through Vyapam for constable posts in Chhattisgarh state police.
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Chhattisgarh GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, Hindi, English, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit vyapam.cgstate.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension
